explication: Apify Agent Skills is a collection of instructions and reference material that equips AI coding agents to work with the Apify platform. The main user workflow is a natural-language scraping request: the agent selects an Actor, shapes its input, manages the run, and formats results. Other major capabilities cover building Actors, wrapping existing code as Actors, and integrating Apify into products. The graph follows the README’s documented workflows and capability areas; individual skill instructions were not sampled, so internal implementation links are limited to those documented relationships.
